findings.title: Production Configuration Hardening
findings.description: Production configuration enforces strict secret keys, secure cookies, separated credentials, and disabled demo routes.

findings.title: AES-256-GCM Token Encryption Key Configuration
findings.description: Active encryption key ID is set and resolves to an AES-256 key for sensitive credential encryption at rest.

findings.title: Caddy Reverse Proxy Security Headers
findings.description: All required security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, -Server) are enforced.
findings.mitigation: Configured in Caddy reverse proxy block.

findings.title: Production OpenAPI and Swagger UI Suppression
findings.description: /openapi.json and /docs are cleanly suppressed in production environment (returning 404).
findings.mitigation: FastAPI openapi_url and docs_url set to None in production.

findings.title: Development & Diagnostic Route Suppression
findings.description: Development routes (/api/v1/dev/*) are strictly unmounted in production mode.

findings.title: CSRF Exemption Whitelist Verification
findings.description: CSRF exemption whitelist contains exclusively unauthenticated and signature-verified webhook endpoints.
findings.mitigation: Strictly audited CSRF_EXEMPT_PATHS set in deps.py.

findings.title: Authenticated CSRF Header Enforcement
findings.description: All 67 authenticated unsafe API endpoints successfully reject requests lacking X-CSRF-Token with 403 CSRF_FAILED.
findings.mitigation: require_csrf dependency applied globally to unsafe methods.

findings.title: Meta Deauthorization Webhook Signature Verification
findings.description: Deauthorization webhook strictly validates HMAC-SHA256 signed_request and rejects invalid/missing signatures.

findings.title: Meta Data Deletion Webhook Signature Verification
findings.description: Data deletion callback strictly validates HMAC-SHA256 signed_request before initiating deletion or issuing confirmation.

findings.title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Permission Separation
findings.description: Permission matrix correctly separates privileges across 25 permissions. Owner retains full control; Manager and Staff are strictly restricted from destructive/administrative actions.
findings.mitigation: Enforced server-side in app/identity/permissions.py via require_permission.

findings.title: OpenAPI Response Schema Information Disclosure Scan
findings.description: All API response schemas use strict allow-lists and expose no passwords, hashes, ciphertexts, access tokens, or private credentials.
findings.mitigation: Pydantic response models with explicit allow-list attributes.

findings.title: Software Composition Analysis (Backend & Frontend)
findings.description: Backend dependencies (pip-audit) report 0 vulnerabilities. Frontend dependencies (npm audit) report 0 vulnerabilities following minimatch ^11.0.4 transitive override.

threat_coverage.T1: Cross-tenant data access: Enforced via PostgreSQL RLS (FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY on all 49 Category C tables), SET LOCAL app.workspace_id GUC binding, and isolation tests.
threat_coverage.T2: Prompt injection via DMs / comments: Untrusted input labelled as data; closed broker tool schemas recheck reference scope; prompt injection heuristics fail closed.
threat_coverage.T3: Prompt injection via pasted text: Knowledge extraction generates candidates only; verbatim excerpt verification required; owner verification mandatory before use.
threat_coverage.T4: Customer text treated as owner instruction: Strict pipeline separation; customer messages never route to CommandService; owner commands require authenticated session.
threat_coverage.T5: Forged webhooks: Mandatory constant-time HMAC-SHA256 verification (X-Hub-Signature-256 for Instagram, signed_request for Meta callbacks); rejects before parsing.
threat_coverage.T6: Replayed or duplicated webhooks: Deduplication keys on inbound_events; unique provider message IDs; idempotent event processing.
threat_coverage.T7: Replayed or stale approvals: Single-use conditional decisions; payload hash + subject version binding; automatic TTL expiry.
threat_coverage.T8: Accidental publication: Exact-payload approval cards; schedule timezone binding; fact updates invalidate pending approvals; publication due-time re-checks.
threat_coverage.T9: Duplicate external effects: External operations ledger (ADR-011); transactional reconciliation; no blind resends on ambiguity (INV-05).
threat_coverage.T10: Token theft: AES-256-GCM encryption at rest; external keys; tokens never in responses, logs, or job payloads; token key rotation job (scripts/rotate_token_keys.py).
threat_coverage.T11: Session theft / CSRF: HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax cookies; X-CSRF-Token on all unsafe methods; session rotation on login; revoke-all on password reset/change.
threat_coverage.T12: Credential stuffing / brute force: Argon2id hashing; generic authentication errors; IP and email exponential throttling (Session 07).
threat_coverage.T13: Malicious uploads: Content sniffing with Pillow; pixel and size limits; re-encoding to JPEG; EXIF metadata stripping; random storage keys; nosniff headers.
threat_coverage.T14: SSRF: Server-side fetching of arbitrary user-supplied URLs prohibited in MVP; pasted text only.
threat_coverage.T15: XSS in SPA: React HTML auto-escaping; dangerouslySetInnerHTML prohibited; strict CSP (default-src 'self', frame-ancestors 'none') in Caddy.
threat_coverage.T16: Demo/mock features in production: Startup configuration validation; /api/v1/dev/* unmounted when DEMO_TOOLS_ENABLED=False; mock providers restricted to demo workspaces.
threat_coverage.T17: Privilege escalation: Server-side permission matrix (PERMISSION_MATRIX) verified on every route and action; staff and managers strictly bounded.
threat_coverage.T18: OAuth CSRF / account mix-up: Cryptographic 32-byte random state; session and workspace bound; 10-minute expiry; atomic single-use consumption.
threat_coverage.T19: Supply-chain / dependency vulnerabilities: Locked dependencies (uv.lock, package-lock.json); pip-audit and npm audit enforced in CI with 0 vulnerabilities.
threat_coverage.T20: Secrets committed: .env gitignored; pre-commit and CI secret scanning; automated OpenAPI response schema inspection.
threat_coverage.T21: LLM data exposure: Prompt data minimization; no customer usernames or IDs in prompts; Zero Data Retention (ZDR) provider posture.
threat_coverage.T22: Abuse via automation loops: Auto-reply rate guard (R16); daily outbound message cap; human approval required by default.
threat_coverage.T23: Agent broker reference scope: Closed tool registry; caller permission and active delegation verified before action; foreign IDs fail closed.
threat_coverage.T24: Stale delegation / owner demotion cutover races: Dynamic membership and delegation verification on each step; in-flight tasks cancelled immediately.
threat_coverage.T25: Public/private context separation in agent runtime: Customer DMs, public comments, and private facts segregated in prompt snapshots and memory services.
threat_coverage.T26: Backup restoration data resurrection: Durable deletion tombstones (deletion_tombstones) fence restored workers and re-apply erasure to older backups.
threat_coverage.T27: Meta callback spoofing: Signed request verification; unguessable confirmation codes; confirmation endpoint reveals no customer identity or data.
